name: Amaze Communications
summary: Sydney dial-up/prepaid ISP (Amaze Technologies Pty Ltd, est. 1996); acquired Holodoc OZ 2000; went into administration Oct 2002, ABN cancelled 2003. NOTE: distinct from SIS Group (Amaze), a later web host that absorbed Bullet Internet.

events.details: Administration (David Levi as administrator); ABN cancelled 2003.
